answer: At the canyon rim an epoch's payout fans into a delta of channels established holders already count. A claim that thins a holder's share earns that holder one call, posted on the juniper rail: take the claim over, answer it yourself, keep the pay, stamp the filer a copy - or stand aside. So a farm cannot force a settlement nobody wants; honest parties harvest its work instead of paying for it. The scarce input is a holder's one-shot call, spent on use and never lent to a sibling, and it goes to whichever claim dilutes most, so a farm's tenth, most redundant head is likeliest to be harvested.
